keyPoints: The prototype meets most evaluation criteria, with repetitive strain injury being a concern.
The team will proceed with the prototype and market the product based on current capabilities.
The kinetic battery concept is being reconsidered, possibly shifting to standard batteries.
Voice recognition is not mandatory for the base product, with an offer as an upgrade.
The prototype cost is under budget at twelve point five Euros.
nextSteps: Discuss with finance the cost implications of switching from kinetic batteries to standard batteries.
Evaluate the feasibility of removing voice recognition from the base product offering.
Confirm with the team the final design specification for the electronics and interface.
